hero.title: Elaina
hero.subtitle: A gray-haired witch who wanders the world, seeking beautiful scenery and interesting stories. Her journey continues — and so does ours.
hero.quote: "The world is vast, and there are still many things I want to see."

aboutOrg.title: Who We Are
aboutOrg.description: elaina-org is a fan community dedicated to preserving and sharing the world of Elaina — from translations and archival to fan art and community events.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To keep the spirit of Elaina's journey alive through translation, preservation, and community building.

story.title: Our Story
story.description: elaina-org started as a small group of fans who wanted to preserve and share the world of Elaina. What began as a translation project grew into a full community — with archival work, fan art showcases, and regular events.
